items.title: Give goose sandbox powers with OpenSandbox and MCP
items.summary: Learn how to give the Goose AI coding agent local sandbox powers using OpenSandbox and MCP. Create, manage, and run code in isolated Docker containers from prompts.

items.title: Let the model suggest, let code decide: notes from AAIF Chennai Connect #2
items.summary: Five talks from AAIF Chennai Connect #2 covered MCP, multi-agent consistency, agentic resource discovery, and CI failure triage. Key takeaway: let the model suggest, let code decide.

items.title: Most agentic work will become workflows
items.summary: Discover how to identify repeated agentic tasks, formalize them into reusable workflows, and optimize them for smaller models and code — saving powerful AI for work that matters.

items.title: We added TOON to our MCP server, then removed it
items.summary: Apify tested TOON token-saving encoding on their MCP server for 30 days. Two A/B tests showed no benefit and higher token costs on key tools, so they removed it.

items.title: Where voice agents fail in production: Part 2 - tools, recovery, and observability
items.summary: Voice agent tool calls can produce duplicates, handoffs can silently fail, and transcripts can hide errors. Learn how to handle recovery, observability, and evaluation in production.

items.title: Agents are applying for jobs: building an open protocol for hiring
items.summary: OJCP is an open standard built on MCP that gives AI agents a documented way to discover, evaluate, and apply to jobs while giving employers signal, consent, and an audit trail.

items.title: Agentic AI Foundation Surpasses 300 Members in Less Than One Year
items.summary: Ant Group, Gates Foundation, MongoDB, Nutanix, Royal Bank of Canada, Vercel, and Vultr join as Gold Members, reflecting growing demand for open, trusted standards for agentic AI.

items.title: Agentic AI Foundation Announces Four New Projects: Agent Skills, Open Responses, OpenEnv, and OpenSandbox
items.summary: AAIF принял Agent Skills, Open Responses, OpenEnv и OpenSandbox. Теперь под управлением фонда десять открытых проектов.

items.title: What Open Responses changes for AI developers
items.summary: Open Responses defines a shared API format for AI model requests, responses, and tool calls, reducing provider-specific integration work across multiple LLM providers.

items.title: Training agents for real-world tasks with OpenEnv
items.summary: Learn how OpenEnv provides a common interface for defining tasks, rewards, and environments to train AI agents on real-world challenges like calendar scheduling and more.

items.title: The Sandbox as an Agent Primitive
items.summary: OpenSandbox is now an Agentic AI Foundation project, providing open source isolated sandbox environments for AI agents with unified APIs, Docker and Kubernetes support.

items.title: Agent Skills: Sharing Team Expertise Across AI Agents
items.summary: Agent Skills joins the Agentic AI Foundation as an open standard for packaging reusable instructions that teach AI agents team-specific tasks. Over 1 million skills published.

items.title: Agentic AI Foundation Launches MCPA Certification to Validate MCP Expertise
items.summary: The first official certification for MCP validates builders’ understanding of MCP architecture, security, and implementation as adoption of the protocol grows.
